-- as.mms --
Blueprint Gem {
  base: Id<item>
  as Id<item> = base hint("gem-base", "Matches any ${base}")
  as LootPoolEntry = Item(name = base)
  emit {
    Function gems/${self.path} {
      /say ${base}
    }
  }
}

Gem ruby { base = emerald }

ItemTag shiny = [ruby, diamond]
LootTable gems {
  pools = [{ rolls = 1, entries = [ruby] }]
}
Recipe bad { type = smelting, ingredient = ruby, result = { id = ruby2 } }
